messages:
anna_docs: opened PR with condensed 429 runbook + small SDK snippets (JS + Python). Need quick sanity-check on recommended fallback order and the header names we use for telemetry. PTAL.

mike_devx: quick note: call out fallback ordering explicitly. our recommended order should be: 1) trim prompt / reduce batch, 2) apply KV prefix caching, 3) fallback to cheaper model, 4) surface as degraded to app.

emma_sdk: added minimal Python example that parses Retry-After and uses exp backoff + jitter. defaults: 3 retries, switch on attempt 3. snippet in PR.

josh_eng: please add `x-rwd-retry-count` and `x-rwd-fallback-used` examples so Console can track. also prefer wording "temporarily degraded" in UX text.

kevin_support: can we include a tiny curl example showing Retry-After handling and the front-end flag {"quality": "temporarily_reduced"} so support can forward to product.

link-bot: found one stale link in docs: `error-ref/429-old.md` -> suggest `error-ref/429-troubleshooting.md`.

deploy-bot: CI started for docs PR 430: link-check + lint (ETA ~6m).

anna_docs: thanks all, I'll push updates (headers, curl + JSON flag, link fix). Will merge after CI green. Ping me if you want to pair on phrasing for fallback order.
